description: A paired dataset comprising approved Computer Science course-overlap pairs from TU/e and anonymized Erasmus+ course-transfer decisions from Leiden University, assembled by Arthur Nijdam et al.
title: TU/e CS overlap matrix and LU Erasmus+ decision set

description: A Turkish-language adaptation of Dweck's four-item scale measuring students' learning goal orientation and performance goal orientation.
title: Turkish adaptation of Dweck's Goal Orientation Scale

description: A 16-item self-report assessment developed for measuring intrinsic, extraneous, germane, and overall cognitive load during simulation-based clinical learning, adapted for Turkish nursing students.
title: Turkish-adapted Simulation Self-Report Cognitive Load Measurement Tool 2.0

description: A 33-item Turkish adaptation of the Students' Motivation toward Mathematics Learning questionnaire, developed by Akçakın for students aged 12–15 and measuring six motivation dimensions separately.
title: Turkish-adapted SMTML questionnaire

description: A 20-item five-point Likert self-report scale developed from Turkey's Middle School Turkish Course Teaching Program and Guide to measure middle-school students' attitudes toward the Turkish course.
title: Turkish Course Attitude Scale (TCAS)

description: A dataset of 790 Turkish-language multiple-choice questions drawn from eight annual Turkish Society of Medical Oncology board examinations for evaluating oncology knowledge and preparing medical oncologists and trainees for board examinations.
title: Turkish Society of Medical Oncology board examination benchmark

description: A Center on School Turnaround at WestEd competency framework identifying high-impact motives, habits, and behaviors for developing leaders responsible for rapid improvement in persistently low-performing schools.
title: Turnaround Leader Competencies

description: TurnNJ is Uncommon Schools' whole-school turnaround programme, implemented in schools in Camden and Newark to extend its school-improvement model to existing schools.
title: TurnNJ

description: A publicly released benchmark comprising Turtle Graphics programming-task datasets, code-evaluation tools, and synthetic-data generation methods, developed by Chao Wen et al.
title: TURTLEAI benchmark

description: Tutor CoPilot is a human-AI tutoring-support tool developed by Wang and colleagues that provides customizable, real-time expert-like guidance to tutors during K–12 mathematics sessions.
title: Tutor CoPilot

description: Tutor Trust is a Manchester charity programme that recruits and trains university students and recent graduates to provide affordable small-group and one-to-one tuition, especially in schools serving disadvantaged pupils.
title: Tutor Trust

description: TutorBench is a source-grounded benchmark dataset created by Bingxi Zhao et al.
title: TutorBench

description: Tutoring with Alphie is a computer-assisted paired-reading literacy programme developed for struggling readers, using paired pupil roles, adult monitoring, and software-guided fluency activities.
title: Tutoring with Alphie

description: Tutoring with the Lightning Squad is a web-based, game-like small-group reading intervention for grades 1–5 that provides paired decoding and fluency tutoring, adaptive activities, and progress monitoring.
title: Tutoring with the Lightning Squad

description: Tutorshop is a Ruby-on-Rails web-based content-management and learning-management system created to deploy CTAT tutors and manage classes, accounts, assignments, and student-progress reports.
title: Tutorshop

description: TutorTrace is a dataset and taxonomy developed by its authors that uses IDE telemetry to classify introductory Python learners' behavioral states around AI help-seeking and support tutor interventions.
title: TutorTrace

description: TutorTrace is a publicly released dataset created by its authors that combines IDE telemetry, AI interaction logs, task outcomes, and expert-validated learner behavioral classifications for studying AI-assisted programming help-seeking.
title: TutorTrace dataset of IDE telemetry, behavioral segments, and observable metrics from 480 learners across four introductory Python deployments
